title: A failed vault create echoed the pasted key back into the agent's chat
summary: The 422 envelope returned the whole request body in what_you_sent, and the only MCP tool that added a vault key sent field names the route refuses, so every call was a 422 that carried the key back into the transcript and stored nothing. Unknown vault fields are now refused by name, a failed key check redacts the key, and the agent surface builds the body from the route's own fields and scrubs any error text before returning it.
references: app/middleware/error_envelope.py — the 422 handler and its what_you_sent echo
app/schemas/integration.py — IntegrationCreate refuses unknown vault fields by name before field validation
packages/mcp-tools/src/admin/brands.ts — create_brand_integration, which sent provider/api_key/label until GKO-12
packages/core/src/gate-setup.ts — addFreeGateKey builds provider_name/credentials and scrubs the key from error text
SpiderIQ card GKO-12 — the agent surface this learning ships with
